_comment: OIDF conformance test-plan configuration — OpenID Connect 'Config OP'
Plan name to select in the suite UI or the API:
This plan reads AXIAM's /.well-known/openid-configuration and its jwks_uri
and asserts they are well-formed and self-consistent. It drives no
authorization flow, registers no client and needs no browser — which is
exactly why it is worth running: it is the one OpenID Connect profile
AXIAM can reach without building the OIDC Core interactive parameter
surface it deliberately does not have. See
render-plan.sh still requires the FAPI client ids and certificate PEMs to
be present in suite.env, because it validates them for every template it
renders. That is a property of the renderer, not of this plan: nothing
below references a client. Run `just conformance-certs` and
`just conformance-register` once and the requirement is satisfied.
description: AXIAM — OpenID Connect Config OP (discovery + JWKS)
